title.en: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES PROFESSIONAL REGULATION COMMISSION AND OTHER CONCERNED GOVERNMENT AGENCIES THROUGH THE DEPARTMENT OF LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT TO CONDUCT A YEARLY SPECIAL PROFESSIONAL LICENSURE BOARD EXAMINATIONS (SPLBE) IN THE KINGDOM OF SAUDI ARABIA, QATAR, THE UNITED ARAB EMIRATES AND OTHER MIDDLE EAST COUNTRIES FOR THE BENEFIT OF QUALIFIED OVERSEAS FILIPINO WORKERS

text.en:
Coverage - The Department of Labor and Employment,
through the Professional Regulation Commission, in coordination with the
Department of Foreign Affairs, Bureau of Immigration, and the Philippine
Professional Organizations - Kingdom of Saudi Arabia shall hold and conduct
Special Professional Licensure Board Examinations for the qualified overseas
Filipino workers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Qatar, the United Arab Emirates
and other middle east countries with whom the Philippines has diplomatic

Implementation Period - The Special Professional Licensure
Board Examinations for the qualified overseas Filipino workers in the Kingdom of
Saudi Arabia, Qatar, the United Arab Emirates and other middle east countries
with whom the Philippines has diplomatic relations shall be held once every year
starting December 2009.

Designation of Venue of Examination and Accessibility -
The Department of Labor, through the Professional Regulation Commission, and
the Department of Foreign Affairs, through its Consular Offices abroad, shall be
jointly responsible in facilitating the required permits from the host country (ies),
the provision of adequate and conducive venue of examinations, and the
processing of travel documents for the personnel who will conduct the Special
Professional Licensure Board Examinations.
POM& Hologram # 50968

Funding - The amount required for the administration of the
Special Professional Licensure Board Examination shall be chargeable against the
Professional Regulation Commission in its appropriate funding sources as included
in its annual budget.

Effectivity - This Executive Order shall take effect
immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 6' day of October, in the year of Our
Lord, Two Thousand and Nine.
Threw th. here
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
POMA Hologram # 50969
